home.star: Give AxonX a Star on GitHub!
home.headline: Financial quant research.
home.lead: An agent-native harness for financial quantitative research. Organize algorithms as plugins, preserve evidence as Tasks, and connect Studio, CLI / MCP, and agents.
home.showcaseLead: From task execution to result interpretation, inspect your research in one workspace.
home.caseTitle: Qlib three-layer research: base, factors and portfolio policy
home.caseDescription: Train on 2015–2022 and evaluate 2023–2026 with 0.05% buy / 0.15% sell fees. Baseline, risk-factor and 3-day strategy Top20 net annualized returns are 7.67%, 9.03% and 32.37%. Results include missing quotes and proxy fills; the strategy is exploratory.
home.closingDescription: The built-in demo needs no external data or model credentials.
